whatsappMessage:
Hi Team Maa Computer,

I noticed your computer sales and service center has earned stellar 4.8★ reviews on SP Verma Rd in Patna, but lacked a dedicated mobile page for customer inquiries.

Maine aapke business ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct WhatsApp repair quote request, computer accessories showcase, aur shop timings integrate kiye hain:

🔗 https://www.arclanestudios.space/sites/maacomputer

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
